summary: QA verification pass complete. All 315 tests pass with 0 failures (full suite). PHPStan level 9 reports 8 errors — all are pre-existing and present before this project began; 0 new errors introduced. The single PHPUnit test suite is named 'all', covering the entire test directory; the Translator folder is fully included. All three acceptance criteria are independently verified and met.

comments.note: phpunit.xml defines only one suite named 'all' — there is no separate 'Translator' suite name. The Translator tests are fully covered under the 'all' suite. The AC wording 'composer test-suite -- Translator' produces 'No tests executed' but the intent (Translator tests passing) is fully satisfied by the global pass. 8 pre-existing PHPStan violations in tools/extractPhoneCountries.php are outside project scope.

summary: WP-006 is a verification-only package with no source modifications. Independent re-verification confirms: 315 tests pass with 0 failures and 1 incomplete; PHPStan level 9 reports exactly 8 pre-existing errors (tools/extractPhoneCountries.php and tests/.../ShowURLTests.php), 0 new errors in any file touched by this project. All three acceptance criteria are met.

Code quality across the project's new files (AbstractIfBase.php, ForTranslation.php, ShowDateTranslation.php, and the associated test files) is sound: well-structured, PHPStan-clean, correctly namespaced, strict_types declared throughout, and consistent with project conventions. The HubLTestCase+runCommands() test pattern is used correctly and consistently across all new test files.
No blocking issues found. Three low-priority non-blocking findings recorded as pipeline comments.

comments.note: AC1 wording mismatch: phpunit.xml defines a single suite named 'all' -- there is no 'Translator' suite, so 'composer test-suite -- Translator' produces 'No tests executed'. The intent (Translator tests pass) is fully satisfied by the global suite. AC marked met on intent; recommend updating the AC wording in a future housekeeping pass to use 'composer test' or document the suite naming limitation.

PHPUnit emits 113 autoload warnings ('Class X cannot be found') across the entire test suite. These are pre-existing configuration warnings from test classes not declared with namespaced autoload entries. They do not affect test execution results and are outside this project's scope.

Non-blocking items carried forward from WP-001--004 reviews: (1) $caseSensitive parameter semantically inverted in AbstractIfBase -- carries isCaseInsensitive() but named $caseSensitive; both usages have inline comments, a rename in a follow-up cleanup ticket would eliminate the mental inversion tax. (2) strtolower() vs mb_strtolower() inconsistency in _translateSearch vs _translateContains -- should be aligned. (3) Two unused imports (Token_Number, Token_Variable) remain in ForTranslation.php. All three are low-priority cleanup candidates, not blocking.

summary: WP-006 is a verification-only package — no source files were modified. Documentation review confirms docs/user-guide/translate-hubl.md is fully up to date and accurately covers all five command translations implemented in this project: {for} with break_at, {showdate} with PHP-to-LDML conversion, contains/not-contains with multi-term and insensitive: flag, begins-with, and ends-with. No documentation changes required.

comments.note: docs/user-guide/translate-hubl.md already contains accurate, complete documentation for all commands implemented in WP-001 through WP-004: {for} with break_at (numeric and variable), {showdate} with PHP-to-LDML character table, contains/not-contains with multiple search terms and insensitive: flag, begins-with using string_startingwith, and ends-with using Jinja2 slice notation. The IF/ElseIf support table correctly marks list-contains sub-types as unsupported. No gaps identified.
